questions.stem: In a predator-prey relationship, what typically happens to predator numbers when prey numbers increase?

options.text: Predator numbers increase after a time lag
Predator numbers increase at exactly the same time

questions.explanation: When prey numbers increase, there is more food available for predators, so predator numbers also increase - but after a time lag. This is because it takes time for the extra food to lead to more predator offspring surviving and growing.
